item.druzhina.commander_baton.follow: Right click: "Follow me!" - your soldiers walk behind you
item.druzhina.commander_baton.hold: Right click the ground: "Hold here!" - a line there, facing where you look
item.druzhina.commander_baton.charge: Shift + right click: "Charge!" - they attack every enemy around
druzhina.role.swordsman.desc: Sword and shield. Takes blows, parries, strikes back.
druzhina.role.spearman.desc: A pike or a boar spear: reaches the enemy first.
druzhina.role.axeman.desc: A halberd or a bardiche: hacks shields apart. Tough, guards worse.
druzhina.role.archer.desc: A bow. Shoots from behind the line, never hits friends.
druzhina.role.knight.desc: The best of the retinue: a yushman or bakhterets, a Rus sword, a shield. Dear, worth three.
druzhina.msg.nobody_hears: None of your soldiers are near
druzhina.msg.army_full: Your band is full: you cannot feed more than %s soldiers
druzhina.msg.baton_given: You were given a commander's baton to give orders with. Hover over it to read how.
druzhina.msg.dismiss_confirm: Shift + right click again to send %s home
druzhina.raid.coming: The lookouts sound the alarm: a band of bandits (%s) comes %s!
druzhina.gui.title: Muster
druzhina.gui.baton_hint: Right click a soldier: his gear; with an item in hand: give it; Shift+right click twice: dismiss
druzhina.role.crossbowman.desc: A heavy crossbow: slow, but it goes through armour.
druzhina.role.militia.desc: A pitchfork or a club, a gambeson. Cheap and weak.
druzhina.role.warrior.desc: A two-handed sword: long sweeping blows, but no shield.
item.druzhina.commander_baton.view: F4 - commander's view: lead your soldiers from above, as in an RTS
druzhina.view.title: Commander's view
druzhina.view.none: None of your soldiers are near: hire them at a muster table
druzhina.view.pick_first: Pick soldiers first: left click one, drag a frame or click a card below
druzhina.role.druzhinnik.desc: A prince's man: Rus mail or scale, a sword or an axe, a round shield.
druzhina.role.shieldbearer.desc: A pavise or a scutum and a short spear: a wall for the archers to stand behind.
druzhina.role.maceman.desc: A mace or a war hammer and a shield: plate is no trouble for him.
druzhina.role.foot_knight.desc: Plate and a great helm; a knightly sword and shield, or a poleaxe in both hands.
druzhina.role.horseman.desc: A mounted retainer in mail, sword and shield, his horse in mail. Cuts from the saddle.
druzhina.role.lancer.desc: The couched lance: a run-up and a crushing charge; his horse barded. A sword at his side.
druzhina.role.horse_archer.desc: Rides round the enemy at a bowshot and shoots at the gallop.
druzhina.role.mahout.desc: A war elephant: tramples and tosses on its tusks; an archer shoots from the howdah.
druzhina.gear.on_foot: On foot: looking for his horse
druzhina.gear.given: Given by you: you can take it back
druzhina.gear.own: His own kit: it cannot be taken, but you can put yours over it; he puts his aside and takes it up again when you take yours back
druzhina.gear.put: Put an item from your inventory here
druzhina.gear.slot.6: Spare weapon: a lancer takes the lance in the saddle and the sword on foot
druzhina.msg.no_seats: No seats left aboard: some of your men wait on the shore
item.druzhina.commander_baton.ship: Right click a ship: your men go aboard, the first takes the helm; aboard a ship your man steers, right click the air: the course, where you look
druzhina.msg.no_timber: %s is holed and the crew have nothing to mend her with: put planks and iron nuggets in her hold
druzhina.msg.no_cloth: The sails of %s are torn and the crew have nothing to patch them with: put string and iron nuggets in her hold
druzhina.formation.line.tip: Line: ranks as wide as the front (drag the right button: width and facing). Z - next formation
druzhina.formation.column.tip: Column: two or three abreast, one behind the other - for roads, bridges and gates
druzhina.formation.wedge.tip: Wedge: a point in front, the ranks widening behind - to break the enemy's line
druzhina.formation.square.tip: Square: as many ranks as files - a dense block that is hard to go round
druzhina.formation.loose.tip: Loose: a line with wide gaps - fewer struck by arrows and cannon balls
druzhina.view.button.hold.tip: H - stand where you are and defend it
druzhina.view.button.charge.tip: C - fall upon every enemy around, keeping no place
druzhina.view.button.fight.tip: R - next right click: fight your way there - strike every enemy met on the way, then form up (same as Ctrl + right click)
druzhina.view.button.patrol.tip: P - next right click: patrol from here to there and back (same as Alt + right click; with Shift - one more point)
druzhina.view.button.ranks.tip: B - keep ranks: men on foot fight only at their places and do not chase; again - fight freely
druzhina.view.button.help.tip: ? (/) - all the keys of the commander's view
druzhina.view.card.tip: Left click - pick them, Shift - add or remove, right click - drop them from the picked, double click - camera to them
druzhina.view.help.1: §6Picking:§r left click a soldier; drag a frame for many; Shift - add/remove; double click - all of that role on screen; Ctrl + left click - all of that role; the cards below - by role; Ctrl+A - all.
druzhina.view.help.2: §6Groups:§r Ctrl+1…9 - remember the picked men as a group, 1…9 - pick the group, twice - camera to it, Shift + digit - add the group to the picked.
druzhina.view.help.3: §6Move:§r right click the ground - march there and form up; drag the right button - the width of the front and its facing. They form up first, march in step and wait for stragglers.
druzhina.view.help.4: §6Queue:§r Shift + right click - the next point of the way after the orders already given (numbers on the ground - the order).
druzhina.view.help.5: §6Fight on:§r Ctrl + right click (or R, then right click) - go there fighting every enemy met; a plain march only strikes back when attacked.
druzhina.view.help.6: §6Patrol:§r Alt + right click (or P, then right click) - walk from here to there and back; Shift+Alt + right click - one more point.
druzhina.view.help.7: §6Attack:§r right click an enemy - the whole troop falls upon him and then stands where the fight ended. Right click a ship - go aboard.
druzhina.view.help.8: §6Orders:§r H - hold, F - follow, C - charge, B - close ranks / fight freely.
druzhina.view.help.9: §6Formation:§r Z - next (Shift+Z - previous): line, column, wedge, square, loose; riders stand in ranks of their own behind the men on foot.
druzhina.view.help.10: §6Camera:§r WASD or the arrows, the mouse at the edge of the screen - move; Q/E or the held wheel - turn and tilt; the wheel - closer/further; with Shift - faster; Tab - to the picked men (or to you).
druzhina.view.help.11: §6On the ground:§r green lines - where each picked man is going; yellow - the troop's way with its queued points.
druzhina.view.help.12: §7F4 or Esc - leave. F4 can be changed in the controls settings (Druzhina).
